In the context of a hypothetical, write the jacket blurb for a thriller where a modern day operative of the FBI, ends up back in the early 1960's having to use her knowledge of "future" forensics to leave clues to enable her modern colleagues to catch a time-hopping serial-killer, before he dies.assistant
response:
"When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to the early 1960s, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old mystery. A serial killer, known only as 'The Timekeeper,' has been terrorizing the nation, leaving a trail of bodies in his wake. But this is no ordinary killer - he's a time-hopper, able to move through the ages with ease.

As Rachel navigates the unfamiliar streets of 1960s America, she must use her knowledge of modern forensic science to leave clues that will help her colleagues catch the killer before he strikes again. But with the Timekeeper always one step ahead, Rachel must rely on her wits and her instincts to stay alive.

With the help of a local detective, Jack, Rachel sets out to unravel the mystery of the Timekeeper's true identity and motivations. But as they dig deeper, they realize that the killer's true power lies not in his ability to kill, but in his ability to manipulate time itself.

As the body count rises, Rachel and Jack must work together to outsmart the Timekeeper and bring him to justice. But with the clock ticking down, they know they have only 13 days to solve the case before the Timekeeper disappears into the timestream once again.

Can Rachel and Jack stop the Timekeeper before it's too late, or will they become the next victims of his twisted game? Dive into this thrilling tale of time travel, forensic science, and cat-and-mouse suspense to find out."
